candidates.issue: SPEC.md requires remove(sku, qty) to raise ValueError if qty exceeds current stock; implementation does item.qty -= qty with no check.
SPEC.md requires low_stock(threshold) to return SKUs with qty <= threshold; implementation uses strict qty < threshold, excluding items exactly at threshold.
SPEC.md states CSV rows are sku,qty,price_dollars and the ledger stores cents; parse_csv_line does int(price) with no dollars-to-cents conversion and cannot parse decimal price strings.
remove() performs item.qty -= qty unconditionally, never raising ValueError when qty exceeds stock, contrary to SPEC.md.
low_stock uses strict < instead of the spec's <=, an off-by-one boundary defect.
